rules_version: those in effect at commencement under Rule 3, unless the parties validly agree on another version
tribunal_composition: one neutral arbitrator appointed under the Rules
arbitral_seat: New York, New York, United States
procedure_terms: The Rules govern notices, appointment, hearings, information exchange, and fees. Any change to those procedures requires an agreement permitted by the Rules and applicable law. This clause does not elect the optional appeal procedure addressed in Rule 34.
